AudioLeveler_target.tip: Every song is brought to this loudness. Use FPP's volume to set how loud the show plays overall. -14 LUFS suits most shows; go louder for an FM transmitter, quieter for a more natural sound with more headroom. The table under this shows what each choice means for your songs.

AudioLeveler_ceiling.tip: The loudest peak allowed, so nothing clips or distorts. FM transmitters boost treble before sending, so peaks close to full scale can distort on air; -1.5 (FPP's Normalize uses the same) leaves room for that.

AudioLeveler_match.tip: Most shows play over FM, to car radios and porch radios, or through outdoor speakers, and those barely reproduce deep bass, so a bass-heavy song can measure on target yet sound quieter. This matching (the same method as FPP's Normalize, which calls it Show speakers / FM) nudges each song's target by up to 4 dB to make up for it. Songs measured before you turn this on need measuring again.

AudioLeveler_bgOffset.tip: For songs set to Background in the Fix column, like ambiance and off-hours music: heard, but under the show.

AudioLeveler_allowLimiter.description: Use the limiter for songs Normalize leaves short
AudioLeveler_allowLimiter.tip: FPP's Normalize never turns a song up past where its peaks would distort, so a quiet song with sharp peaks can end up a little under the target. With this on, those songs get Audio Leveler's gentle 4x-oversampled limiter instead, which brings them all the way up but rewrites the file (the original is kept as a backup). Off, files are never changed and those songs simply land a little quieter. You can also pick Limiter for a single song in its Fix column.

AudioLeveler_lossless.tip: Like MP3Gain: changes an MP3's volume in 1.5 dB steps without re-encoding, so there's no quality loss at all. Used whenever a song only needs turning up or down. Songs that need the limiter or compression, and other formats, are re-encoded at top quality (MP3 at 320 kbps).

AudioLeveler_autoLevel.tip: Handles songs and videos added or changed after you switch this on (an upload from xLights, say). It checks when FPP starts, whenever a playlist stops, and when you open this page, then measures them and applies each one's fix once no show is playing. Ones set to Skip are left alone, and a file that's still uploading waits for the next check.

AudioLeveler_backup.description: Keep originals so they can be restored
AudioLeveler_backup.tip: Keeps the original of each song or video the first time it's changed, in plugindata/AudioLeveler/backups.

AudioLeveler_waitIdle.description: Wait until no show is playing
AudioLeveler_waitIdle.tip: When off, work runs at low priority during the show, but a song is never replaced while it is playing.
